# BigChalkBox — AI Examination Suite for Indian Universities

> BigChalkBox is an AI-powered platform built by BCBX Innovations Private Limited that automates the entire examination lifecycle for Indian universities and colleges: handwritten answer sheet evaluation, question paper moderation, AI question paper generation, and detailed student feedback.

## Key Facts

- Product Suite: BigChalkBox Academic Suite (DASES, QP Moderation, QP Generation, Teacher Notes, Exam Prep)
- Company: BCBX Innovations Private Limited
- Website: https://bigchalkbox.com
- Category: Educational Technology / AI Examination Automation
- Country: India
- Founded: 2024

## Core Capabilities

- DASES: Reads and evaluates handwritten student answers with 98% rubric accuracy
- DASES: Processes up to 500 answer sheets in parallel — each in approximately 15 seconds
- QP Moderation: 10-point AI audit of question papers (Bloom's, ambiguity, out-of-syllabus, OR parity)
- QP Generation: Syllabus-aware, anti-repeat, Bloom's-balanced question paper generation in seconds
- AI-generated rubrics from model answers
- QuickPass™ paper quality analysis before exams
- Downloadable branded PDF reports for students
- Syllabus coverage tracking linked to course outcomes
- Student portal for viewing evaluation reports

## Who Uses BigChalkBox

- Faculty and Teachers: Create papers, define rubrics, review AI grades
- Students: View detailed evaluation reports and provide feedback
- Department Heads and Administrators: Track activity and analytics
- IQAC and NAAC Committees: Compliance reporting and Bloom's taxonomy documentation
